need: R764 ordinary paused map frame left CharacterLifestyleWindow+0xF8 unbound, so LIFE4 could not enumerate legal focuses; the perk-only stock fallback did not cover focus selection.

window_independent_source.producer: CCharacterLifestyleWindow candidate refresh RVA 0x132CB70, focus loop RVA 0x132CE0A..0x132CF78
window_independent_source.read_rule: Load the already-published database pointer without invoking lazy initialization; scan every bounded stable key and require exactly one fixed target. A null/unreadable database is unavailable, not a known-empty candidate list.

stock_final_legality.source_chain: The validator resolves command+0x20 via exact Character storage, compares command+0x28 with current focus, checks command+0x30 player identity, then invokes character focus gate RVA 0x26694A0 and FocusType final gate RVA 0x2D88E60. The final gate evaluates scripted is_shown/is_valid through 0x334C510. No lifestyle-window owner argument is passed.
stock_final_legality.result_rule: Two identical observed native booleans in one paused application-main frame are legal or rejected observations; a failed source/read/ABI/exception is unavailable. No command is submitted.

target_lifestyle_progress_observation.scope: same paused source-bound stock focus read only; no focus command is submitted
target_lifestyle_progress_observation.source: The unique stock target definition's lifestyle pointer at +0x880; use the exact-build GetLifestyleXp RVA 0x2668B80, GetPerkPoints RVA 0x2668A00, GetPerkPointsUsed RVA 0x2668A80, and lifestyle XP-per-level at +0x138. Do not substitute current-lifestyle LIFE2 state.
target_lifestyle_progress_observation.output: For observed_native_legal/illegal, target_lifestyle_key and target_lifestyle_progress are emitted. presence=present requires source=exact_native_getters plus integer xp_total_raw, xp_within_level_raw, xp_per_level, unspent_perk_points, used_perk_points. presence=unavailable has reason=target_native_getters_unavailable and no numeric fields.
target_lifestyle_progress_observation.binding: Capture twice with the definition identity, player, native legality, target lifestyle key, and all target progress values unchanged in one paused application-main frame. A getter fault, invalid value, or drift never becomes zero.
target_lifestyle_progress_observation.consumer: parse_player_lifestyle_focus_private_v1 binds request ID, private non-advertised read-only flags, source snapshot/episode and independent after frame. It returns observed, target_progress_unavailable, or red; every native unavailable_* source/read/ABI status remains red and is not legal false. No production action registration.
target_lifestyle_progress_observation.live_state: pending sole-owner readback on the new source; R0112 preceded this extension and proves only stock focus legality, not target progress

downstream_compatibility.wire_change: additive fields on the private default-OFF stock-focus-v1 response only; no public capability list, production action, checkpoint schema, or open_kaishek consumer is changed
downstream_compatibility.reuse: The exact-build native reader and Python typed parser may back a future versioned read-only MCP query after paused readback. No MCP/public registration is claimed or advertised by this package.

player_binding.requirement: Global full CharacterID, CCharacter+0x18, and paused frame played ID match on both samples.

implementation.focused_tests: M4-FOCUS-OBS stock focus MSVC /W4 /WX /permissive- /Od and /O2 5/5 each GREEN; private bridge Debug and Release DLL links GREEN; private Python focus query/parser plus existing formal consumer normal and -O 17/17 each GREEN

next_gate: With the rebuilt private DLL on an ordinary paused frame, the sole CK3 owner must invoke the default-OFF private read-only step and independently verify target-lifestyle progress, not just stock focus legality. Typed focus submit, independent post-frame focus key, next production turn, and checkpoint/cold restore remain separate later gates. This static source alone does not close M4.
